show.description: Cold-hearted billionaire Vikram Mehra and struggling singer Sunita are forced into a sudden contract marriage under unexpected circumstances. As their worlds collide, one of wealth, secrets, and control, the other of dreams, resilience, and warmth this unlikely bond sparks real emotions. But when fake vows start feeling real, love becomes the most unpredictable twist of all.
